endpoint: Videos with transient isolated-frame output distortion, classified by the author as quality-/motion-associated model failure, separately from mechanism-related dynamic cut-in.
appearance: One or two isolated frames per affected video with abrupt sampling-line deviation towards the left atrium; identified by comparison with neighboring frames and expected temporal continuity.
possible_mechanisms: Abrupt image-quality degradation, respiratory motion or probe movement; attributed by the author, not independently adjudicated or quantitatively tested.
supersedes: Unqualified zero-event paired cut-in interpretation in v0.1.4; prior release is historical.
